_about: Crime, Bounty and Infamy, after Fable (Godot build: game/systems/law.gd). A crime only counts if someone sees it: a townsperson or a guard within `witnessRange` metres with no wall between. A seen crime adds its `bounty`, makes you Wanted at once if it is `wanted`, (coins owed to the reeve of the `jurisdictions` entry whose `regions` hold the place) and its `infamy` (lasting), and you show Amber for `amberSeconds` while the nearest guard of that jurisdiction comes over: a first small offence there (bounty under `warnBelow`) earns a warning; otherwise pay the fine, go quietly to the `gaol`, or resist (you are then Wanted there, as you are once your bounty reaches `wantedAt`). Guards (enemies with `lawful: "guard"`) attack the Wanted on sight; dying while Wanted wakes you in the gaol, the bounty paid from your purse. Infamy of `outlawAt` or more makes you an Outlaw everywhere, and the `hunter` comes for you on the roads every `every` seconds (min, max), a level stronger each time he is beaten. Merchants charge `markup` percent more from each step of Infamy, and will not serve an Outlaw. Infamy fades only by atonement: the reeve takes `atone.coinsPerPoint` coins a point for the widows' fund. Livestock and guards (`lawful` enemies) can only be attacked while the `crime` key (Alt) is held, so a mis-click never makes you a criminal.

warn: Oi. I saw that. First and last time, understood? Go on, before I change my mind.
That's Corrick's beast you've had. Once, I'll let it go. Twice, and it's the lock-up.
fine: Stop right there. You've broken the peace. That's {bounty} owed to the reeve. Pay it now, or come quietly.
I know your face now. {bounty} to the reeve, or a night in the lock-up. Your choice.
outlaw: You. I know what you are. Drop the blade.

pk._about: PK points for player killing, after Conquer Online (Law.pk_*). Killing an innocent player (white name, not flashing) adds `perKill` points and `infamy` Infamy. Striking an innocent makes you flash (blue) for `flashSeconds`: anyone may hit or kill you then without PK points. Red and black names are fair game too. Points fade by `decay.points` every `decay.seconds` you are alive in the world. Names: red at `red`, black at `black`. On death a red name drops each worn piece with `drops.red` chance (at most `drops.max`), a black name with `drops.black`; quest items, tool packs and cosmetics never drop. The watch attacks a black name on sight.
